title: text insert

messages.description: pointer to the text if -s flag is used

arguments.description: array name if no flags are given

flags.name: -s <symbol, symbol>
flags.description: struct name and field name of main structure

body: [text insert] inserts a line into a text, before the line number set by the argument or the middle inlet. The text is named by the argument or the right inlet, or found through a pointer with -s.
